description: Icons for the data on 3 surfaces: (B) panel row glyphs in the Paths tab / node lists, (A) 3D billboard camera-facing markers replacing bare spheres, (C) 3D floating type/label overlays via egui world->viewport projection
wave_rationale: UI/render enhancement. Surface B is trivial (extend existing sidebar glyph pattern); A needs a new ~15-line billboard system (no face-camera code exists today); C is an egui screen-space overlay. Independent of pen_autocreate but shares path_editor_card.rs + path_point_interaction.rs, so batch sequentially.
notes: User: 'we should have icons for the data' — chose all 3 surfaces. Recon 2026-07-13: no billboard system exists; egui renders monochrome recolorable unicode glyphs (sidebar.rs:306 diamond/circle precedent); TEXT_VIEWPORT_HINT is the overlay-text precedent for C; type discriminants = GPX_TYPE_KEY (track/waypoint/trackpoint), has_asset, time_seconds, materialization_kind. Single-point node must stay AABB-pickable (keep a Mesh3d for its Aabb).
